name: get_order
description: Fetches one order by its order number. Use this first for any question about a specific order. Returns {order_id, status, items, total_usd, shipping_address, tracking_url}. Returns {error: 'not_found'} if the number doesn't match; in that case ask the customer to double-check it.

order_id.description: Acme order number, format 'AC-' plus 8 digits, e.g. AC-20481937.

name: refund_order
description: Issues a refund to the original payment method. This moves money and can't be undone: only call it after the customer has confirmed the order number and amount. Amounts over $200 are rejected with {error: 'needs_human'}; use handoff_to_human instead. Returns {refund_id, amount_usd, eta_days}.

amount_usd.description: Refund amount in US dollars, up to the order total and at most 200.

reason.description: Why the customer wants a refund.

name: email_customer
description: Emails the customer on file for an order a short plain-text summary of this conversation. Use only when the customer asks for a written summary. It can't send to any other address. Returns {sent: true} or {error} if the order has no email.

order_id.description: Order whose customer will receive the email.

summary.description: Plain text, under 1,000 characters. No card numbers.

name: search_help_center
description: Searches Acme's help-center articles for policies (returns, shipping, sizing). Use it for any policy question instead of answering from memory. Returns up to 5 matches as {title, url, snippet}, or an empty list when nothing matches. In that case, say you'll check with a colleague and hand off.

query.description: Plain-language search, e.g. 'return window for sale items'.

name: handoff_to_human
description: Transfers the conversation to a human support specialist, with a summary so the customer doesn't have to repeat themselves. Use it when the customer asks for a person, stays upset after one attempt, requests a refund over $200, or raises legal, medical or safety issues. Returns {ticket_id, expected_wait_minutes}.

reason.description: One line on why you're handing off.

summary.description: What the customer needs and what you've already tried.
